h:
H3 是一个视频模型，但通过 Mamad8 的单图像 VAE 准确渲染 R2V 的一帧，它成为一个严肃的基于指令的图像编辑器。该技术归功于 Patient_Ratio4177。这是它的 Apple Silicon 端口，因为原始配方仅支持 CUDA（int8_convrot + nvfp4 + comfy-kitchen）。

仓库中有什么（github.com/Bambushu/h3edit-mac）：

- ComfyUI 工作流程（GGUF Ref2VA + lightx2v Turbo LoRA + ClipProj、sa_solver/8、完全 MPS）

- h3edit CLI：一个命令，两个参考图像输入，一个编辑输出

- 一个微小的自定义节点，无需修补 ComfyUI 的源代码即可解锁 1 帧渲染（更新后仍然存在）

- 4 个带有完整提示的有效演示 + 1 个诚实的失败

在 M5 上每张 2208x960 图像大约需要 7-10 分钟。所有演示品牌都是虚构的且由人工智能生成。

o.en:
H3 is a video model, but render exactly ONE frame of R2V through Mamad8's single-image VAE and it becomes a serious instruction-based image editor. Credit for the technique goes to Patient_Ratio4177. This is the Apple Silicon port of it, since the original recipe is CUDA-only (int8_convrot + nvfp4 + comfy-kitchen).

What's in the repo (github.com/Bambushu/h3edit-mac):

- the ComfyUI workflow (GGUF Ref2VA + lightx2v turbo LoRA + ClipProj, sa_solver/8, fully MPS)

- a h3edit CLI: one command, two reference images in, one edit out

- a tiny custom node that unlocks 1-frame renders WITHOUT patching ComfyUI's source (survives updates)

- 4 worked demos with full prompts + 1 honest failure

~7-10 min per image at 2208x960 on an M5. All demo brands are fictional and AI-generated.
